name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
description: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person action role-playing, survival horror and immersive sim game in the System Shock series.

eax.problem: This is the 25th Anniversary Remaster, not the classic System Shock 2, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic 1999 System Shock 2, that one has EAX — it's no longer sold, but existing owners keep it.
